items.text: Spike test for an editor integration. First run pwd. Read README.md. Then make a small two-file edit: create docs/SPIKE.md with a one-sentence summary of what this repository is, and append the line '<!-- capy-acp spike -->' at the end of README.md. Then run git status --short and git diff --stat. Reply in at most three sentences. Do not commit, push, or open a pull request.

I ran `pwd` (`/home/dev/capy-acp-spike/sandbox`) and read README.md, then created `docs/SPIKE.md` with a one-sentence summary and appended `<!-- capy-acp spike -->` to the end of README.md. `git status --short` shows ` M README.md` and `?? docs/`. `git diff --stat` shows only `README.md | 1 +` because the new file is untracked, and nothing was committed or pushed.
